deps.why: the Hub's package is FM-1 SID as an fm1-dock solo app, and the v0.3 release notes say 'Built from c2e231f with RELEASE=0.3 dock/build_solo.sh on fm1-dock e177e83': dock/build_solo.sh takes fm1-dock's tree from FM1_DOCK (default ../fm1-dock, outside the repository); this is that commit (its module interface firmware/dock/hb_module.h and modules/lib/hb_fm1.h, which dock/ compiles against, and the Dinghy platform and fake FM-1 the native build runs the module on)

reSID 0.16, which tools/fetch_ext.sh downloads unpinned from zimmers.net into ext/resid-0.16 and dock/solo/module.cfg compiles: this mirror's 'Initial import of resid-0.16.tar.gz', every one of its 56 files byte-identical to zimmers.net's resid-0.16.tar.gz (sha256 830fe4c048053338c8f4c38decdedd93d8c101583958d62536d669f3ac7a66f3, compared 2026-11-19)

firmware/gen_assets.py (run by dock/build_solo.sh) renders the screen font from DejaVu Sans Mono, read from DEJAVU_MONO or Debian's /usr/share/fonts (outside the repository; the README: matplotlib's on macOS): this mirror's DejaVu 2.37, its ttf/DejaVuSansMono.ttf byte-identical to dejavu-fonts' own version_2_37 release (dejavu-fonts-ttf-2.37.tar.bz2, sha256 b4a6c3e4faab8773f4ff761d56451646409f29abedd68f05d38c2df667d3c582, Debian's 2.37). Its 8x12 font comes out the same as from matplotlib's DejaVu 2.35, and the native screens' text matches the Hub package's pixel for pixel
